title: SunTime Charter Boats
specs: Captain Bill holds a U.S. Coast Guard Master Captain's License with 20 years experience
Boat equipped with private bathroom, shower, LED lighting, surround sound Bluetooth speakers
Each adult must complete three forms prior to the boat tour
includes: Iced down built in cooler, floats, goggles and more
blurb: Guests join Captain Bill, a U.S. Coast Guard Master Captain with 20 years experience, for boating excursions including sunrise or sunset watching, dolphin and manatee spotting, island visits with sandbar walks and swimming, bioluminescence viewing, and rocket launch watching. Custom excursions are available. Food and drinks can be brought by guests, excluding glass containers and red wine.
extraNote: 20% gratuity for the captain is customary and not included in the charter rate · Guests may bring their own food and drinks except glass containers and red wine
